maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells chlor alkali, epoxy and ammunition as new products, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Chlor alkali, epoxy and Winchester ammunition are sold to industrial customers, distributors and consumers, not mainly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its chemical plants and Winchester ammunition operations, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Largest part is commodity chlor alkali and epoxy, which customers can buy elsewhere on price.

notes: Some specialty products, such as an insulin ingredient made only at Stade, are harder to switch away from, but they are a small part of the business.
